messages:
Maya (AE): FYI Sentinal Health wants to run a 4-week POC. they listed: private deployment (VPC), HSM-backed key management, model pinning to a 13B family, 5k embeddings/minute steady with 30k spikes, and SLA on 99th perc latency. attached their RFI + security questionnaire. who can own technical answers?
Ethan (SE): I can take tech onramps. quick Q: are embeddings CPU or GPU? they said 'embeddings' but not seq len. 5k/min is ~83/sec, ok but depends on model/quant.
Maya (AE): customer says 512 tokens avg per request for text, embeddings are 768-d vectors. they'll share sample payloads in the attached zip.
Liam (Solutions Eng): we'll want to propose: Dedicated VPC + reserved capacity, HSM integration via KMS proxy, and a fallback hosted endpoint for bursts. note: quantized 13B gives big perf gains for embeddings.
Priya (Security): Please upload the security questionnaire PDF and their network diagram. I need to map to SOC2 controls and KMS/HSM attestation. also: do we have a documented attestation for customer-managed HSM (bring-your-own)?
Casey (CS): I'll run the onboarding checklist and coordinate a test dataset. Can do a runbook for the POC steps and handoff to ops.
Maya (AE): Attached: sentinel_rfi_q1.pdf and sentinel_sample_payloads.zip (uploaded to sales drive). also linking the customer's network diagram: https://drive.redwood/sentinel/netdiag.png
Ethan (SE): rough ask from SE side: need sample qps traces + a 1-hour tail-latency trace. send them this quick perf script to generate a synthetic load:
Ethan (SE): ```bash
for i in {1..5000}; do curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-quant","input":"short text","max_tokens":512}' & done
```
Liam (Solutions Eng): for cost estimates: propose reserved 2x A100 per shard + burst pool. I'll draft capacity numbers. also recommend prefix caching for stable embed workloads.
Priya (Security): Security checklist immediate asks:
- KMS/HSM: HSM model, attestation, key rotation cadence
- Data residency: where does KV cache persist? encryption at rest details
- Logging: audit log retention and access controls
- Network: can we support private peering and customer IP allowlist?
Please mark which we can answer now vs need engineering signoff.
Maya (AE): customer also flagged a legal clause requiring subprocessor list + SOC2 AICPA report. Legal will need to provide subproc list.
Casey (CS): I'll gather subproc list and sample SOC2 report. also create a POC timeline doc and invite stake-holders for kickoff next Wed 10am PT.
Ethan (SE): I'll start drafting the RFI responses for latency, throughput, model pinning, fallback policies. tagging Priya for security writeups @Priya (Security).
Priya (Security): noted. I'll start mapping answers and add FedRAMP mapping where applicable. drop any customer-supplied encryption requirements here.
Maya (AE): Action items recap: Ethan = RFI technical answers + perf script, Liam = capacity/cost proposal + caching plan, Priya = security questionnaire mapping, Casey = onboarding runbook + SOC2/subproc. Maya = schedule kickoff and send NDA amendment request.
redwood-bot: Reminder set for kickoff: 2024-06-12 10:00 PT.
Maya (AE): thanks team. I'll upload a draft RACI to the sales drive later today. :thumbsup:
Ethan (SE): small note — if they insist on customer-managed HSM we need engineering signoff on connector. I'll ping runtime infra.
Liam (Solutions Eng): ok, will queue an infra review.
Casey (CS): sending calendar invites now.
Priya (Security): pulling their questionnaire into our tracker, will flag any blocker items by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
